notes.title: "Noroi Kago: the Grudged Domain" Full Release On Steam Now!
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of "NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain" .

Through the demo version and early access, we have received valuable feedback from all of you and continuously updated the game to improve the experience.

We sincerely thank you for your support.
We are pleased to announce that the game is now Full Released.
Thanks to your continued encouragement, we have completed preparations for the Full Release.
We will continue updating the game going forward, so we hope for your continued support.


[h3]ver.1.0.0 Update Details[/h3]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
•　Added Yuki-Onna
•　Added Mine Stage
•　Added DLC (new characters)

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
•  Fixed minor bugs

[h3]Other[/h3]
 •  DLC (Original Soundtrack) is now available for purchase

We will be rolling out updates based on your feedback to deliver an even better horror experience.
Please share your thoughts with us through the Steam Community or X (formerly Twitter):

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1299060/discussions/
https://x.com/noroikago_en

Additionally, "Noroi Kago: the Grudged Domain" welcomes your streaming and gameplay commentary.
We hope both viewers and streamers will have an exciting time sharing the experience through streams and videos!

notes.title: Update Announcement: New Yokai "Gashadokuro"
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain".
We have an exciting announcement about our upcoming major update!

On March 26, we will introduce the new yokai "Gashadokuro" along with its exclusive new stage, "Village"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185307/bc9f3f3380b702aa31a6711d4b1dd777751be487.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185307/8b3177b295b51c2dc6ccf2c834089b6e3db1431e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185307/410237970c098f2820151a92b9f647ae2971c60b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185307/db71f3f480c6eec130be75869c93a87ac5ea26a7.png[/img]

Gashadokuro is a fearsome yokai that takes the form of a massive skeleton.
It looms over the center of Village, dominating the area.
With its gigantic arms, it swings and smashes with overwhelming force, while its detached right arm roams freely, relentlessly hunting down players.

Escaping from Village, ruled by Gashadokuro, will require a different approach compared to other stages…

The update is currently in active development, and we can’t wait to share more with you.
Thank you for your continued support of "NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain".

notes.title: 【Extra-Boss Added】Major Update Announcement ver.0.2.0
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of "NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain".

We are excited to announce a major update to enhance your experience and bring you even more terrifying gameplay.

Starting today, the new yokai "Zunberabo" has been added as an Extra-Boss!
The Extra-Boss system allows players to add an additional yokai to the stage alongside Gyuki or Hyakume, increasing the challenge. (Of course, you can still play with only one yokai as before.)
The newly introduced Zunberabo mimics the appearance of players and approaches them unnoticed. Cooperation among players will become even more crucial.
Enjoy the heightened challenge and intense gameplay!

[h2]Update Details[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
Added Extra-Boss "Zunberabo".
Expanded the Field of View (FOV) adjustment range in the options menu.
[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
Increased movement speed while in the downed state.
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Fixed minor bugs.

We are planning even more updates to make "NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain" even more enjoyable. Stay tuned for future improvements!

notes.title: Upcoming Update: New Yokai "Zunberabou"
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of "NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain" .
We are excited to announce a major upcoming update!

In early February, we will be adding a new yokai, "Zunberabou", the faceless creature!
[previewyoutube=Y09SR2iw3hg;full][/previewyoutube]

"Zunbera" is a faceless yokai that disguises itself as a teammate, slowly approaching you before attacking when you least expect it. This terrifying new addition will bring a heightened sense of tension to "Noroi Kago", where cooperation is key. But can you truly trust the person approaching you? You may need to communicate even more carefully than before.

We are currently working hard on the February update, and more updates will follow after that. Stay tuned!
